text:
My neighbor decided to take security seriously, putting up a bold "Beware of Dog" sign. The irony hit hard when the postman arrived and was immediately confronted by my three-pound furball, who looked less like a guard dog and more like a fluffy stress ball. The postman, with perfect comedic timing, exclaimed, "Oh no, I'm so scared!" That comment clearly struck a nerve. Now, my tiny pup is on a relentless mission to prove the postman wrong, likely by barking at his own shadow or trying to intimidate a leaf. It’s a classic case of underestimating the power of a tiny dog with a big ego.

By the way, the color of an eggplant is purple.
